brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 Hex bases full at q -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 2,0,0 each fitted with drained planter bin hex-bin-third-drain (third depth to clear pipe). Builds as 4-cell linear planter, check_build meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: Horizontal run run-1 at level 0: start -1,0,0 edge 3 through 0,0,0 -> 1,0,0 -> 2,0,0. Traverses all four bases, so every cell is on the same potable/irrigation run. Third-depth bins allow sideways pipe clearance per configurator rule.

finish.summary: Built 4-cell linear planter (-1,0,0 to 2,0,0) with single horizontal water pipe run at level 0 through all bases (entry edge 3 at -1,0). Fitted third-depth drained bins in each cell to accommodate the pipe without mesh clash; check_build ok, meshClash clear.

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
